patch_description: Replace the 24 independent rotation parameters per block with three collective parameters, reducing the full model from 146 to 20 parameters. This directly targets the current overfitting gap and poor parameter efficiency. The two complementary CZ banks together cover every qubit pair exactly once, matching the all-pairs feature encoding while preserving permutation symmetry. Placing collective RX and RY mixers around the phase-processing layers converts IsingZZ-encoded phases into measurable Z populations, while the intermediate collective RZ controls interference. This regularized, symmetry-aligned structure should recover the stronger accuracy and much faster convergence observed for collective complete-graph designs.
